title: Health page — choose the composition
question: Log today's numbers first, 30-day trends beneath. Same world (band, paper, one card, ledgers). Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: One big chart, a tab per metric
options.lineage: the lab-results screen: one chart at a time, the log beside it
options.thesis: Sleep, water, weight, resting HR are tabs above a single large 30-day chart; the log for today sits in a ruled column beside it; pills and appointments run beneath as ledgers.
materials: serif tabs with an ink underline
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, 'Health', italic 'as of 8.40 am'. Paper: left 4/12 'Today' as ruled fields (water tally with plus/minus, sleep hours, weight, resting HR) and a pills checklist; right 8/12 the chart card with metric tabs and a 30-day line, then 'Appointments and refills' ledger under it.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three; only one trend is visible at a time, so a glance can't compare sleep against weight.

regions.label: Today: water · sleep · weight · HR (ruled fields)
Sleep | Water | Weight | HR  — one 30-day chart card

options.label: Today's ledger, then a strip of four trends
options.lineage: a daily log sheet with the month's graphs pinned along the bottom
options.thesis: The whole top of the page is today: one wide ruled ledger of everything to log (water, sleep, weight, HR, pills, next appointment) with inputs inline; beneath, four small 30-day charts in a row, one per metric, all visible at once.
materials: four small chart panes on paper rules (no cards)
one white card reserved for the water tally
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, 'Health', 'Tuesday · logged 3 of 6'. Paper: 'Today' ledger rows full width — each row: metric name, today's input, last value, note; pills as checkboxes in the same ledger; then 'Last 30 days' as four side-by-side ruled charts (sleep, water, weight, HR) with their averages.
options.risk: Four small charts at ~260px each are readable for shape, not detail; inputs inside ledger rows must be clearly editable.

regions.label: Today: ruled log rows with inline inputs (water, sleep, weight, HR, pills, appointment)

options.label: The morning card over tall trends
options.lineage: the home's One Card rule applied to health: today's log is the card, the month is the paper
options.thesis: Today's log is the page's single white card — compact, all six things to log in one place with big serif numerals; below it the 30 days run as tall ruled charts stacked two-by-two directly on the paper, with pills and appointments in a right-hand ledger column.
materials: one white log card with the system shadow
options.viewport: Band: wordmark, 'Health', italic date. Paper: left 8/12 — the Today card (water tally with plus/minus, sleep, weight, HR as serif numerals with inline inputs), then 'Last 30 days' as two rows of two tall charts; right 4/12 — 'Pills' checklist ledger and 'Appointments and refills' ledger.
options.risk: Tall charts push appointments below the fold at 900px; the card must stay compact or the page reads as two hero blocks.

regions.label: Today card: water · sleep · weight · HR
